title: Oh My Pi
intro: The Pi fork with its own extensions, headless over --mode json. Sessions resume by the id the stream announces; thinking levels, MCP servers, service tiers and stateless runs pass through.

verified.how: hg harness run against DeepSeek, two turns

notes: models.yml is written every turn with one provider, hg, whose api follows the provider's shape (anthropic-messages by default).
MCP servers in the request's tools are written to .omp/mcp.json.
The session id comes from the first line of the JSON stream and is kept for --resume.
